blocks.text: Penicillin aik taqatwar antibiotic hai jo bohat si bacterial infections ke ilaj mein use hoti hai, jaise saans ki infections maslan strep throat, pneumonia, scarlet fever aur sinusitis. Yeh jild aur naram tissues ki infections jaise cellulitis aur erysipelas ke ilaj mein bhi madad deti hai.

Penicillin ki banawat mein do bunyadi halqe hain: chaar rukni beta-lactam ring aur paanch rukni thiazolidine ring, dono ke saath side chains juri hain. Beta-lactam ring antibiotic ke asar ke liye zaruri hai; yahi woh jagah hai jahan beta-lactamases naam ke bacterial enzymes hamla kar ke penicillin ko be-asar kar sakte hain.

Cell wall mazboot karne wala bacterial enzyme penicillin ko apni aam tameeri ikai samajh leta hai. Enzyme penicillin molecule le leta hai, beta-lactam ring khulti hai, aur penicillin enzyme se mustaqil jur jati hai, jis se enzyme be-kaar ho jata hai. Bacteria barhte rehte hain, lekin kaam karne wali cell wall ke baghair aakhir phat kar mar jate hain. Insani cells ki cell wall nahi hoti, is liye penicillin hamare cells ko nuqsan nahi deti.

blocks.title: Penicillin kis se milti hai
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke penicillin 'enzyme ke amino acid sequence jaisi' dikhti hai. Zyada durust yeh hai ke penicillin enzyme ke aam substrate (cell wall ki tameeri ikai ka D-alanyl-D-alanine wala sira) se milti hai, khud enzyme se nahi, isi liye enzyme ise pakar leta hai. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

blocks.alt: Baen: penicillin ka markazi hissa. C=O group wali chaukor beta-lactam ring (narangi) apne nitrogen ke zariye paanch rukni thiazolidine ring (neeli) se juri hai jis mein S, do CH3 groups wala carbon aur COOH wala carbon hai; chaukor ring se NH-CO-R side chain juri hai. Daen: chaar dabbe: cell wall ka enzyme penicillin le leta; beta-lactam ring khul kar mustaqil jurti aur enzyme rok deti; bacterium kaam karti deewar ke baghair barh kar phat'ta; insani cells ki deewar nahi, nuqsan nahi.
blocks.caption: Penicillin: banawat aur asar (asal khaaka; banawat Figure 32.2 ke mutabiq dobara banayi gayi).
blocks.long_description: Tanao wali chaar rukni beta-lactam ring reactive hissa hai. Jab yeh enzyme ke andar khulti hai, penicillin enzyme se juri rehti aur bacterium apni deewar nahi bana sakta.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: 1928 mein Alexander Fleming ne ittefaqan penicillin daryaft ki jab unhon ne dekha ke aaloodah petri dish par ugne wali phaphoond (mould) ne gird ke bacteria maar diye the. Yeh phaphoond, jise baad mein Penicillium pehchana gaya, aisa maddah chhorti thi jo bacteria ki barhotri rok deta. Is ittefaqi mushahide se pehli antibiotic bani aur jadeed tibb badal gayi.

blocks.prompt: Penicillin insani cells ko nuqsan kyun nahi deti?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bacterial cell wall ki tameer rok kar kaam karti hai, aur insani cells ki cell wall nahi hoti.

items: Penicillin: thiazolidine ring se juri beta-lactam ring.
Yeh cell wall ka enzyme rokti; bacteria phat'te.
